item.title: Dangerous wall - structurally unsound, 25th September
item.description:
The wall to the car park vehicle entrance behind the shops of place farm estate (birkdale close entrance) is structurally unsound. Approx 3m x 2m section of the upper wall is lifting away from the bottom section. Daylight is visible between mortar and bricks. The proximity of the wall next to a busy nursery/ walk through to shops/infant & primary school makes this incredibly dangerous, should it fall. The area needs to be cordoned off/temporarily propped as a matter of urgency.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 1, Place Farm Avenue, Crofton, Greater London
